Commodity Macro Signal — Initial Release

- Provides macro analysis of global commodity markets using free-tier Finskills API data.
- Covers key commodities: energy (oil, gas), precious and industrial metals, agriculture, and major commodity indices.
- Synthesizes trend and direction signals (1M/3M/YTD) for inflation and economic growth assessment.
- Maps commodity movements to macro signals (e.g., oil/gold/copper trend implications) and asset class impacts.
- Offers sector-level impact analysis with actionable insights for equities, bonds, and alternative assets.
- Requires a Finskills API key (free tier supported) for all data retrieval.
